cases.asserts: answer path writes retrieval_log then citation_verification_records then answer_audit_record, in that order, before the envelope is emitted
refusal path writes retrieval_log (when adapter was reached) and refusal_record; pre-retrieval refusals write refusal_record only
hash-only default: records contain query sha256, no raw query text, no excerpt fields
excerpt opt-in flag adds bounded excerpt; flag absent or non-'true' stays hash-only
trace_id identical across all records of one request; getRecords(trace_id) reconstructs the full sequence
sink rejection on answer_audit_record converts the response to error envelope; no unaudited answer escapes
partial-sequence failure (later write fails after earlier succeeded) also converts to error; earlier records remain for forensics

invariants: no audit record ever contains legal body text or fixture excerpt content in hash-only mode
audit_record_ref in every envelope resolves to a record in the mock sink
